title: Growth of Titania Nanotubes on Laser Powder Bed Fusion Printed Ti6Al4V ELI
authors: H. Jadhav, P. Pawar, M. Tak, S. S. V. Tatiparti, S. S. Pande and R. G. Mote
abstract: The growth of electrochemically anodized titania nanotube (TiNT) arrays is strongly influenced by the microstructure of the underlying titanium substrate. In Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF), this microstructure is governed by the processing parameters, yet the relationship between LPBF processing, microstructural evolution, electrochemical dissolution behavior, and TiNT growth remains poorly understood.
